dict.Formele tale (făcute cu ✒ Traseu → ◇ Def: Your shapes (made with ✒ Path → ◇ Define Custom Shape): pick one and drag it on the picture
dict.Șterge forma proprie aleasă din listă (f: Delete the selected custom shape from the list (shapes already placed on the picture stay)
dict.Traseul devine o formă proprie, de pus o: The path becomes a custom shape, to place at any size from ✎ Annotate → Custom shapes (outlined or filled)
dict.Traseul e prea mic pentru o formă: trage: The path is too small for a shape: draw it bigger.

templates.Am făcut „{0}”: o găsești în ✎ Adnotează: Made “{0}”: you will find it in ✎ Annotate → Custom shapes.
